description: Get the chronological activity log for an incident — {incident, activities:[...]} (who acknowledged/resolved/commented and when). Spike: GET /incidents/{counterId}/activity-log (team-scoped).

teamId.description: The 24-char hex team _id to scope this request to (x-team-id). Omit to use the configured default (SPIKE_TEAM_ID). List ids with spike_list_teams.

name: spike_get_incident_activity_log
